description: This file defines the 'Folder' class in PHP, representing a folder in the SuiteCRM email module. It manages retrieving folder data from the database, handling folder IDs, and integrating with mailbox preferences. The class includes methods for loading folder information, validating folder IDs, and determining display properties.

classes.name: Folder
classes.description: A model class that represents an email folder within SuiteCRM. It handles folder retrieval, validation, and display logic, acting as a proxy for folder data within the email module.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves folder information from the database given a folder ID and sets internal properties accordingly.

methods.name: retrieveFromRequest
methods.description: Loads folder data based on a request array containing the folder ID, updating session state.

methods.name: loadMailboxFolder
methods.description: Determines and loads the appropriate mailbox folder based on user preferences, session data, or request parameters.

methods.name: getMailbox
methods.description: Returns the mailbox name associated with the folder.

methods.name: isSelectedForDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the folder ID is marked for display.

methods.name: getFirstDisplayFolder
methods.description: Retrieves the first folder suitable for display.
